pieces.label: SOAP SCUM?

pieces.say: Here's the bathroom shortcut. Warm white vinegar on ceramic tiles.
Dust or vacuum loose hair first.
Spray warm white vinegar. Not on natural stone.
Wipe, rinse, then dry so spots don't return.
Never use vinegar on marble, and don't mix it with bleach.
pieces.text: No vinegar on stone. Never mix bleach.

pieces.say: Tiles that actually look clean again.

[intrigued] Here's the bathroom shortcut. Warm white vinegar on ceramic tiles.
